title: The payer's balance is the same on its Invoices tab, A/R Aging and statement
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer A, the customer the work is for.
  • Have a new customer for this test, customer B, the payer.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 1, for customer A, invoiced today for $210.00, billed to customer B, unpaid.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 2, for customer B, invoiced today for $95.50, that bills itself, unpaid.
  • Have a new work order for this test, work order 3, for customer A, invoiced today for $40.00, that bills itself, unpaid.
custom_steps:
1. Open customer B's Invoices tab.
  2. Open the A/R Aging report for today.
  3. Open customer B's statement.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • Work order 1's invoice ($210.00) and work order 2's invoice ($95.50) are listed.
  • The balances add up to $305.50 ($210.00 + $95.50).

Step 2:

  • Customer B's row shows $305.50.
  • Customer A's row shows $40.00 (work order 3 only).

Step 3:

  • Customer B's statement lists both invoices and a balance of $305.50.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Bill To", Confluence 1003585538, version 0.5 (6 Nov 2026, pending approval, Chris Ward), read 9 Nov 2026 · Epic SV-12289, story SV-12312 (Story 10, Receivables follow the Bill To)

  • S10-R1: “The invoice's receivable posts to the Bill To's account, on its Invoices tab, AR Aging and statements.”
  • Feature Overview, Core Bill To: “The Bill To owns the receivable: payment terms and due date, credit limit, Credit Hold, Customer PO and "PO is required", deposits, payments, credits, the QuickBooks invoice customer, IBS, the portal Pay button and the invoice email.”
